---
title: "Fit repeated directions"
description: "Fit an animal-level random intercept and compare marginal and conditional predictions."
---

In `Sandhopper`, each animal has five trials. Put one trial on each row
and convert the directions from degrees to radians. The term `(1 | Anim)`
adds a random intercept for each animal.

```{r}
library(CircularRegression)
data(Sandhopper)

trials <- paste0("LN", 1:5)
vars <- c(trials, "Azimuth", "DirW", "SpeedW")
wide <- Sandhopper[complete.cases(Sandhopper[vars]), ]
wide <- head(wide, 24)
d <- wide[rep(seq_len(nrow(wide)), each = length(trials)), ]
d$y <- as.vector(t(as.matrix(wide[trials]))) * pi / 180
d$ref <- d$Azimuth * pi / 180
d$wind <- d$DirW * pi / 180
d$speed <- d$SpeedW / max(d$SpeedW)

fit <- angular_re(y ~ ref + wind:speed + (1 | Anim), data = d)
fit$fit_status
coef(fit)
```

For a conditional prediction, `predict()` reads `Anim` in `newdata` and
adds the estimated shift for that animal. Compare the two predictions for
the first trial.

```{r}
trial <- d[1, ]
c(
  marginal = predict(fit, newdata = trial, type = "marginal"),
  conditional = predict(fit, newdata = trial, type = "conditional")
)
head(ranef.angular_re(fit), 3)
```

Use `plot_ranef.angular_re()` to display the estimated shifts.
[Full grouped example](angular-regression-workflow.html#random-intercept-fit).
